data.name: Trivedi
data.gender_notes: Trivedi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Trivedi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Trividh' which means 'three ways'. It is believed that this name brings prosperity, wealth, and good fortune to the bearer. In Hindu mythology, Lord Ganesha is known as the Trividh, the one who bestows three types of blessings - knowledge, fortune, and happiness. The name Trivedi carries the meaning “The One who brings prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Trivedi usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who brings prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the attainment of spiritual wealth and inner peace.
data.etymology: Trivedi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One who brings prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Trivedi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

This name is regarded as a symbol of completeness and wholeness, and it is believed to bring blessings of wisdom, prosperity, and good fortune to its bearer. In Hindu society, it is a respected and honorable name which is associated with scholarship and intellectual prowess.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Trivedi is believed to be a representation of the divine trinity of Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva. The name signifies the union of the three principles of creation, preservation, and destruction, leading to spiritual growth and enlightenment. It is a reminder that the universe is made up of diverse elements, and that we must strive to maintain balance and harmony in all aspects of our lives. Additionally, the name Trivedi is believed to give the bearer a deep connection to the divine and a strong sense of spiritual purpose.
